svg.title: Winding Stair — vertical tower interior
svg.desc: Alternating stair flights wrap the central shaft. Window seats and lamplighter shelves punctuate the ascent; maintenance ladders and a bell rope offer shorter routes. Reach the Solar through the highest door.
svg.text: A continuous climb inside the tower shaft
